mode: Three abstract plants: rage pea (500), counterattack walnut (501), and independent shooter pea (519). Shooter pea has an original projectile-pea head on the native animated stem, firing tumbling whole native peashooters every 1.5 seconds for ordinary pea damage without moving itself or adding knockback. Adventure 1-8 unlock, 125 sun, 3-second card cooldown; integrated chooser, almanac, previews, sandbox and versioned save/resume. Old 502-518 identities remain retired, not reused. Other plants/zombies and the two retained characters keep their previous behavior.
